name: Lightfused Brilliant Silver
tooltip:
Lightfused Brilliant Silver
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
A higher grade of silver, Brilliant Silver's shine is as unmatched as its magical conductive properties. It is highly sought after as the epitome of form and function.

Drenched in the Sunwell's glow, some ore deposits in Quel'Thalas gleam with incredible radiance. Touching these deposits will release motes of holy energy that burn if caught, but yield additional resources.

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
